messages:
sam_sales: Hi team — OrchardHealth dropped a security packet and asked for a short POC next week. CAIQ + brief infra diagram attached in the drive. link: https://drive.google.com/orchard-packet :paperclip:
mira_security: grabbing it now. quick question: do they explicitly require data residency in eu-west-1? that affects whether hosted is viable.
sam_sales: they mentioned EU residency in the intake form and said 'data must remain in EU for PHI', but didn't call out which deployment mode.
leo_architect: from infra side: if EU-only and BYOK, Private (VPC) or Dedicated in eu-west-1 is the safe path. hosted is possible if we can guarantee region pin and our hosted KMS path is acceptable.
devops-bot: Ticket created: RWI-4901  Security intake (orchardhealth). Assigned: mira_security.
mira_security: ack. i'll triage and post required evidence list. basic ask: KMS ARNs, key policy, SOC2 org-level cert + scope, pen test summary, and a sketch of PII flow.
carla_cust: (customer) Hi all — we can provide AWS KMS ARNs and SOC2 PDF. For pen test we have a redacted report we can share. We need the POC in eu-west-1 next tuesday-thursday. Is that doable?
tina_solution: quick check: do we need BYOK for the POC or will customer-managed key for prod only? if they can accept our hosted KMS for demo that reduces setup time.
carla_cust: we prefer BYOK but for demo can accept hosted with a short-term key escrow if necessary. need to confirm word from security.
mira_security: note: short-term key escrow is an option but requires signed attestation and a temporary key lifecycle policy. i'd prefer getting their ARNs. also need confirmation about whether they will seed any PHI into the POC dataset.
sam_sales: asked customer to confirm PHI presence and to send ARNs + rotation policy by EOD (48h).
leo_architect: rough resource estimate for week-long eu-west-1 POC with BYOK: ops time 1.5 engineer-days, infra spin 0.5 day, gpu hours 60 (estimate) — cost delta vs hosted: ~2.5x.
mira_security: checklist i'm posting (will attach to RWI-4901):
```
- KMS ARNs + key policy (documented)
- Data residency confirmation (eu-west-1)
- PHI processing? Y/N (if Y, bring DPA + Data Flow Mapping)
- SOC2 (PDF) + which services in scope
- Penetration test summary (redacted ok)
- Logging evidence (CloudTrail / SIEM retention)
- Any regulatory controls (HIPAA BAAs) needed?
```
sam_sales: thanks — i'll nudge them. if they can accept hosted for demo we'll save a week.
carla_cust: confirmed — no PHI will be used in the demo. sending ARNs & SOC2 now.
mira_security: great. i'll change PHI to 'no' in RWI-4901 and mark as lower risk. will still need pen test summary and key policy.
tina_solution: once ARNs land i can draft a minimal infra playbook for the POC and send a cost delta.
leo_architect: if they send a non-AWS KMS provider we'll need to evaluate key-wrapping. callout: we currently support AWS KMS (ARN) and Azure Key Vault for BYOK without extra platform time.
sam_sales: customer replied with two ARNs and SOC2 PDF link: https://drive.google.com/orchard-soc2. forwarding. :thumbsup:
mira_security: received. i'll validate key policy and SOC2 scope later today and post findings. if all good, i'll reduce gating items to pen test and logging screenshots.
sam_sales: thanks. can we get an estimated go/no-go by tomorrow morning? customer wants to schedule POC kickoff.
mira_security: aiming for morning. if i see issues i'll flag immediately.
